author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-t3-turbo
title: T3 monorepo with Turborepo
description: create-t3-turbo: Next.js and Expo in the same repo sharing an API with tRPC, Drizzle, Better Auth and UI, all typed end to end with Turborepo.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Apps in `apps/` (`nextjs`, `expo`) and packages in `packages/` (`api` with the tRPC routers, `db` with Drizzle, `auth`, `ui`, `validators`).
- The API is written once in `packages/api` and both web and mobile use it; never duplicate an endpoint inside an app.
- Run from the root: `pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
